detail: Run against this repo post-migration: 1,514 records ingested from the committed tree, 170 decisions + 385 entries, semantic MRR 0.012 / keyword 0.038 on the single depends_on pair — identical to the pre-migration file-backend run. Exp-2 mean Jaccard 0.572 vs 0.445 is not a backend difference: corpus-derived task sampling shifted with the grown corpus.
summary: retrieval-ab now reads sqlite corpora (db rebuilt from records/ tree). Parity holds: exp-1 identical to the file-backend run; exp-2 deltas are task-sampling variance.
